message.content: {"reason": "The current 0.763 ceiling comes from two coupled issues: high-cardinality interaction categoricals are too expensive/noisy for greedy tree splits on 8k rows, and the fusion weight/threshold are tuned on the same OOF vector used to report accuracy, creating real selection optimism. Historical successes favor full-data retrain plus a heterogeneous CatBoost/LightGBM blend, while failed TE experiments mostly failed on fold ownership and bundle persistence rather than the representation idea itself. Therefore the most promising refinements are a leakage-safe, persisted target-encoding layer in feature engineering and a nested stacking/threshold protocol in training_evaluation, without changing the output contract or fold protocol.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Add a prior-smoothed target encoder (m≈20, encoding=(sum_y + prior*m)/(count+m)) for the high-cardinality interaction keys `coupon_occupation`, `coupon_income`, and also `coupon_time`/`coupon_exp`; feed these as numeric columns to LightGBM while keeping the raw interaction categoricals available only for CatBoost, and persist `maps_`, `prior_`, `m`, and `te_col_names` in the bundle. WHY: The current LightGBM must discover coupon×who/time/expiration conditional base rates through many arbitrary integer-coded splits; a well-smoothed numeric TE gives the same signal at much lower variance, and historical failures show TE is safe only when fitted fold-internally and loaded read-only at predict time. HOW: implement `fit_target_encoding(df, y, fold_ids, m=20)` and `transform_target_encoding(df)`; inside each CV fold fit maps only on that fold's training rows and assign each training row an encoding from the other folds (its own label never contributes), while validation rows use the same fold-train maps; for final full retrain fit maps on all training rows, and at predict call only `transform_target_encoding` with saved maps and fall back to stored `prior_` for unseen/NaN levels. Preserve existing `clean_features`/`engineer_features` signatures, `FEATURES` order for CatBoost, and add separate `LGB_FEATURES`/`CAT_FEATS_LGB` so the CatBoost categorical contract remains unchanged while LightGBM uses numeric TE columns plus low-cardinality categoricals only.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Replace the ad-hoc joint `(w, threshold)` search over the averaged OOF vector with a nested stacking layer: train a regularized logistic-regression meta-learner on OOF logits from CatBoost, LightGBM, and a third cheap `HistGradientBoostingClassifier` on the encoded numeric/TE matrix, and choose the decision threshold from an inner CV of the meta-learner rather than from the same OOF vector used to fit its weights. WHY: The current 891-point grid search on a single ~8k-row OOF sample carries winner's-curse selection variance, while a 2–3 parameter meta-learner plus inner-CV threshold uses fewer effective degrees of freedom and exploits heterogeneous calibration between model families; historical successes favor full-data retrain and metric-aligned accuracy selection, while failures warn against refitting TE or selecting on the same OOF vector. HOW: inside the existing 5-fold `StratifiedKFold` repetitions (seeds 42 and 1042), collect OOF probabilities for CatBoost, LightGBM (when available), and HGB trained on the fold-specific TE matrix; convert to logits, run an inner `StratifiedKFold` over the OOF rows to fit/evaluate the meta-learner, select the threshold maximizing inner-OOF accuracy, then fit the final meta-learner on all OOF logits and persist `meta_model`, `meta_features`, `threshold`, `hgb_model`, blend/fallback metadata, and TE state in the bundle. Preserve the median best-iteration full-data retrain, all existing random seeds, CLI, `row_id=0..N-1` input-order output, original-label mapping, and the read-only fresh-process predict path that loads and never refits."}}
